Q5028.reason: A brochure and a recorded plat merely proposing a school site do not create a covenant, equitable servitude, or accepted public easement, so the designation is unenforceable.

Q5787.reason: Stipulated intent only to inflict a slight wound supplies no malice aforethought; that battery intent transfers and an unintended killing during the unlawful act is involuntary manslaughter.

Q5115.reason: At exercise onset glycolysis accelerates and forms pyruvate faster than mitochondria can oxidize it, so lactate production rises.
